run_pipeline_hunyuanimage_refiner: run the HunyuanImageRefinerPipeline to refine an input image with a text prompt and distilled guidance scale
encode_prompt_with_qwen: encode a text prompt into hidden state embeddings using the Qwen2.5-VL text encoder with template formatting
prepare_image_latents_for_refinement: prepare image latents by encoding an input image through the VAE and reordering token dimensions
denoise_latents_with_guidance: denoise latent representations through the transformer denoising loop with guidance-distilled scheduler steps
retrieve_timesteps_from_scheduler: retrieve timesteps from a diffusion scheduler using num_inference_steps, custom timesteps, or custom sigmas
